title: Verify T4 downstream gate observability and auditability
objective: Audit how T4-generated AppraisalSignals interact with downstream settlement gates (residual creation, wake chain triggers, and same-day composition with T1/T2) to verify gate behavior remains observable, auditable, and stable when T4 negative relational signals enter the pipeline.
exact_scope: IN: Instrument or inspect downstream gates to expose decision paths when processing T4-generated AppraisalSignals; verify observability of same-day T2/T4 composition behavior; verify auditability of residual creation gate decisions involving T4 inputs; verify visibility of wake chain triggers activated by T4 signals; establish logging or tracing if gaps prevent observation. OUT: Modifications to T4 signal emission logic; modifications to T1/T2 bridge implementations; modifications to settlement substrate state contracts; expansion of social event taxonomy; implementation of new gate algorithms; fixes for stability issues discovered (report only).
constraints: must not break existing 205 passing tests
must not introduce live LLM or probabilistic logic
must constrain audit to narrow T4 activation path only (no deferred tick expansion)
must not alter core gate logic—only verify observability
acceptance_criteria: T4-generated AppraisalSignals produce observable traces when processed by residual creation gates
Same-day T2/T4 signal composition on identical relationship targets generates auditable decision logs
Wake chain triggers activated by T4 signals are inspectable in system output or logs
Downstream gate behavior with T4 inputs remains deterministic and repeatable across identical inputs
required_tests: test that T4 negative relational signal triggers residual creation gate with observable outcome
test that same-day T2 positive and T4 negative signals on same target compose without crashing and produce auditable result
test that T4 signal activates wake chain trigger with visible propagation trace
non_goals: do not modify T4 signal generation logic (completed in P26B-T2)
do not refactor T1/T2 bridge implementations
do not redesign settlement substrate contracts
do not implement fixes for stability issues discovered (deferred to P26B-T4)
do not expand event taxonomy beyond narrow social event path
